title: VyaparPulse Payment
description: Payment record. NOT specified by an example in the architecture doc — this is a Phase 1 design decision, needed so revenue, payments-received and outstanding amounts can stay distinct (section 5) and to support collection-rate / outstanding-ratio / payment-reliability features (section 6). Replace or reconcile with the actual backend payment model once the real repository is available.

transaction_id.description: Foreign key to the transaction this payment applies to.

amount_paid.description: Amount actually collected. May be less than the transaction amount (partial payment).

status.description: 'paid' = amount_paid >= transaction amount. 'partial' = some but not all collected. 'pending' = no payment received yet.
